cards.headline: Basal Laminar Deposits and Pseudodrusen

source.title: Basal Laminar Deposits and Pseudodrusen: Rethinking Their Role in Age-Related Macular Degeneration Progression.
source.excerpt: BLamD is a key pathologic feature in AMD, particularly in eyes with pseudodrusen. Their presence may contribute to disease progression, highlighting the need for further research into their prognostic significance and potential as therapeutic targets. A critical consideration is the need to improve multimodal imaging recognition, facilitating their identification in future clinical studies.

cards.headline: Regulation of lens water content: Effects on the physiological optics of the lens

source.title: Regulation of lens water content: Effects on the physiological optics of the lens.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Furthermore, because the lens pressure gradient can be regulated by intrinsic and extrinsic stimuli, we suggest mechanisms via which this integrative system can be used to effect the changes to the refractive and transparent properties of the lens that are observed across our lifetime.

cards.headline: Cell therapy in the cornea: The emerging role of microenvironment

source.title: Cell therapy in the cornea: The emerging role of microenvironment.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: Optimization of the success rate of cell therapies obviously requires high-quality cultured cells/products, but the role of the surrounding microenvironment is equally important to allow engraftment of transplanted cells, to preserve their functions and, ultimately, lead to restoration of tissue integrity and transparency of the cornea.

cards.headline: Diabetic Retinopathy and Quality of Life: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

source.title: Diabetic Retinopathy and Quality of Life: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: This study found that VRQoL declined with the presence and severity of DR. Interventions to reduce progression of DR at both early and more advanced stages could improve VRQoL.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence in orthodontics

source.title: Artificial intelligence in orthodontics: clinical maturity, evidence gaps, and emerging applications-a narrative review.
source.excerpt: Future progress is likely to depend on robust prospective clinical trials, transparent reporting, and responsible integration of AI into evidence-based orthodontic practice and the broader digital transformation of dentistry.

cards.headline: Navigating the new frontier

source.title: Navigating the new frontier: technical, humanistic, and ethical skills in AI-augmented stroke care for vascular neurologists: a scoping review.
source.excerpt: Artificial Intelligence can enhance stroke care when combined with rigorous clinical oversight and strong ethical and humanistic foundations.

cards.headline: Deutscher Kaiser

source.title: Deutscher Kaiser
source.excerpt: Der Begriff deutscher Kaiser hat drei miteinander verbundene Bedeutungsdimensionen. Ideengeschichtlich verweist er erstens auf die im 19. Jahrhundert wirksam werdende Verbindung von Monarchievorstellungen und nationalen Einheitsideen. Verfassungsgeschichtlich bezeichnet er zweitens das im Staatsaufbau des Deutschen Kaiserreiches verankerte Amt des Kaisers als konstitutionelles Staatsoberhaupt.

cards.headline: SOCIODEMOGRAPHIC FACTORS AS PREDICTORS OF DIABETIC RETINOPATHY SCREENING

source.title: SOCIODEMOGRAPHIC FACTORS AS PREDICTORS OF DIABETIC RETINOPATHY SCREENING: A Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: This review demonstrates that sociodemographic factors significantly affect DR screening adherence. Strengths include the broad geographic scope and diversity of populations studied. Limitations involve study heterogeneity and occasional reliance on self-reported data.

cards.headline: TFOS DEWS III: Executive Summary

source.title: TFOS DEWS III: Executive Summary.
source.excerpt: The three comprehensive TFOS DEWS III reports and accompanying editorial are freely available for download from the AJO website (www.ajo.com).

cards.headline: Facedown Positioning in Macular Hole Surgery

source.title: Facedown Positioning in Macular Hole Surgery: A Systematic Review and Individual Participant Data Meta-Analysis.
source.excerpt: This study provides low-certainty evidence that FDP improves the anatomic and visual outcomes of macular hole surgery modestly and indicates that the effect may be more substantial for macular holes exceeding 400 μm. The findings support recommending FDP for patients with macular holes exceeding 400 μm pending further investigation.

cards.headline: The applications of artificial intelligence in liver transplantation

source.title: The applications of artificial intelligence in liver transplantation: A comprehensive scoping review.
source.excerpt: Progress towards clinically deployable tools will require harmonised, higher-granularity datasets, consistent reporting, and prospective evaluation within real-world transplant workflows.

cards.headline: AI Integration in Indonesian Education

source.title: AI Integration in Indonesian Education: Trends, Outcomes, and Challenges - A Comprehensive Review.
source.excerpt: These findings underscore the urgent need for a responsible AI implementation framework in Indonesia one that incorporates standardized AI literacy competencies for teachers, locally contextualized ethical policies, and a functional national roadmap for AI-enabled educational transformation.

cards.headline: Parlamentswahl in Indien 1951–1952

source.title: Parlamentswahl in Indien 1951–1952
source.excerpt: Die Parlamentswahl in Indien 1951–1952 war die erste landesweite Wahl zum gesamtindischen Parlament nach Inkrafttreten der Verfassung der Republik Indien am 26. Januar 1950. Die Wahl zog sich über mehrere Monate, verteilt auf verschiedene Tage hin, begann am 25. Oktober 1951 und endete am 21. Februar 1952. Wahlberechtigt waren mehr als 173 Millionen Personen und die Wahlbeteiligung betrug 44,9 %.

cards.headline: Rethinking aerobic metabolism in retinal rod outer segments

source.title: Rethinking aerobic metabolism in retinal rod outer segments: Triple metabolic hypothesis and clinical implications.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: This perspective revisits the conventional view that oxidative phosphorylation in photoreceptors is restricted to inner segment mitochondria and highlights new directions for investigating retinal bioenergetics and pathophysiology.

cards.headline: Was Wir an Versen aufheben oder in Vergessenheit geraten lassen - Wir bringen bessere …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:106
source.excerpt: ما نبدِّل من آية أو نُزِلها من القلوب والأذهان نأت بأنفع لكم منها، أو نأت بمثلها في التكليف والثواب، ولكلٍ حكمة. ألم تعلم -أيها النبي- أنت وأمتك أن الله قادر لا يعجزه شيء؟

cards.arabic: ۞ مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ أَوْ نُنسِهَا نَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ مِّنْهَآ أَوْ مِثْلِهَآ ۗ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
cards.translation: Was Wir an Versen aufheben oder in Vergessenheit geraten lassen - Wir bringen bessere oder gleichwertige dafür. Weißt du denn nicht, daß Allah zu allem die Macht hat?
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Meaning of Naskh: Ibn Abi Talhah said that Ibn `Abbas said that, مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ (Whatever a verse (revelation) do Nansakh) means, "Whatever an Ayah We abrogate."

cards.headline: Weißt du denn nicht, daß Allah es ist …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:107
source.excerpt: أما علمتَ -أيها النبي- أنتَ وأمتك أنَّ الله تعالى هو المالك المتصرف في السموات والأرض؟ يفعل ما يشاء، ويحكم ما يريد، ويأمر عباده وينهاهم كيفما شاء، وعليهم الطاعة والقَبول. وليعلم من عصى أن ليس لأحد من دون الله من وليٍّ يتولاهم، ولا نصير يمنعهم من عذاب الله.

cards.arabic: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ
cards.translation: Weißt du denn nicht, daß Allah es ist, Der die Herrschaft über die Himmel und die Erde hat, und daß ihr außer Allah weder Schutzherrn noch Helfer habt?
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Meaning of Naskh: Ibn Abi Talhah said that Ibn `Abbas said that, مَا نَنسَخْ مِنْ ءَايَةٍ (Whatever a verse (revelation) do Nansakh) means, "Whatever an Ayah We abrogate."

source.excerpt: We are entering a new era in the treatment of retinal and choroidal vascular diseases and this issue is designed to provide a guidebook of what is here and what is about to come.

source.title: Ocular adverse events associated with antibody-drug conjugates used in cancer: Focus on pathophysiology and management strategies.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: In collaboration with oncologists, ophthalmologists play a vital role in caring for patients with cancer by assisting with the prompt recognition, mitigation, and management of treatment-related ocular AEs.

cards.headline: Cardiovascular Disease and Age-Related Macular Degeneration

source.title: Cardiovascular Disease and Age-Related Macular Degeneration.
source.excerpt: The strong association between SDDs to HRCVDs merits further investigation, especially in cardiovascular patients with SDDs carrying the high-risk alleles for AMD. Further prospective studies in both HRCVD and AMD patients are needed to elucidate the totality of clinical and genetic factors that drive AMD.

cards.headline: Drug delivery across the blood-retinal barrier

source.title: Drug delivery across the blood-retinal barrier: Biological gateways for posterior segment therapy.
source.publisher: Progress in retinal and eye research
source.excerpt: By integrating retinal biology, pharmacokinetics, materials science, chemistry, and clinical ophthalmology, this review provides a gateway-centered framework for the rational design of next-generation drug delivery strategies for posterior-segment diseases.

cards.headline: Social Determinants of Dry Eye in the United States: A Systematic Review

source.title: Social Determinants of Dry Eye in the United States: A Systematic Review.
source.excerpt: Most SDOH indicators studied were associated with unfavorable dry eye measures, such as a higher disease burden, worse symptoms, or delayed referral, in the United States. Future investigations between SDOH and dry eye should use standardized instruments and address the domains in which there is an evidence gap.

cards.headline: Morgagnian Cataract: Clinical Features, Surgical Management, and Outcomes

source.title: Morgagnian Cataract: Clinical Features, Surgical Management, and Outcomes.
source.excerpt: Morgagnian cataracts were associated with profound visual loss, pressure-related complications, and zonular weakness, with substantial intraoperative risk. Despite this complexity, half of the operated eyes achieved BCVA of 20/40 or better. IOP decreased after cataract extraction in the setting of continued medical therapy in many eyes.

source.excerpt: This bibliometric study employs visualization techniques to delineate AI's transformative role in carotid artery research, demonstrating its potential to redefine research paradigms and drive sustained advancements through advanced data analytics.

cards.headline: Artificial intelligence and academic anxiety? a meta-analysis

source.title: Artificial intelligence and academic anxiety? a meta-analysis.
source.excerpt: AI interventions significantly reduce academic anxiety with a moderate effect size. Although efficacy varies descriptively across several factors, most subgroup differences are not statistically significant.

cards.headline: Oder wollt ihr vielmehr euren Gesandten bitten …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:108
source.excerpt: بل أتريدون -أيها الناس- أن تطلبوا من رسولكم محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم أشياء بقصد العناد والمكابرة، كما طُلِبَ مثل ذلك من موسى. علموا أن من يختر الكفر ويترك الإيمان فقد خرج عن صراط الله المستقيم إلى الجهل والضَّلال.

cards.arabic: أَمْ تُرِيدُونَ أَن تَسْـَٔلُوا۟ رَسُولَكُمْ كَمَا سُئِلَ مُوسَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ ۗ وَمَن يَتَبَدَّلِ ٱلْكُفْرَ بِٱلْإِيمَـٰنِ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
cards.translation: Oder wollt ihr vielmehr euren Gesandten bitten, so wie zuvor schon Musa gebeten worden war. Wer den Glauben mit dem Unglauben vertauscht, der ist fürwahr vom rechten Weg abgeirrt.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
cards.body: The Prohibition of Unnecessary Questions: In this Ayah, Allah forbade the believers from asking the Prophet numerous questions about matters that did not occur yet.

cards.headline: Viele von den Leuten der Schrift möchten euch, nachdem ihr den Glauben (angenommen) habt …

source.title: Sure Al-Baqarah, 2:109
source.excerpt: تمنى كثير من أهل الكتاب أن يُرْجِعُوُكم بعد إيمانكم كفارًا كما كنتم من قبلُ تعبدون الأصنام; بسبب الحقد الذي امتلأت به نفوسهم من بعد ما تبيَّن لهم صدق نبي الله ورسوله محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم فيما جاء به، فتجاوزوا عمَّا كان منهم من إساءة وخطأ، واصفحوا عن جهلهم، حتى يأتي الله بحكمه فيهم بقتالهم (وقد جاء ووقع) ، وسيعاقبهم لسوء أفعالهم. إن الله على كل شيء قدير لا يعجزه شيء.

cards.arabic: وَدَّ كَثِيرٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَوْ يَرُدُّونَكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ كُفَّارًا حَسَدًا مِّنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِهِم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَٱعْفُوا۟ وَٱصْفَحُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِىَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
cards.translation: Viele von den Leuten der Schrift möchten euch, nachdem ihr den Glauben (angenommen) habt, wieder zu Ungläubigen machen, aus Mißgunst von sich selbst aus, nachdem ihnen die Wahrheit klargeworden ist. Doch verzeiht und seid nachsichtig, bis Allah mit Seiner Anordnung kommt! Allah hat zu allem die Macht.
cards.reflection: Was nimmst du heute aus diesem Vers mit?
